subject.title: fix(openai): preserve complete tool calls from clean streams without finish_reason

question: Should OpenClaw treat native `delta.tool_calls` plus raw SSE `data: [DONE]` as sufficient to execute tools when an OpenAI-compatible provider omits final `finish_reason`?
rationale: The implementation appears correct, but deciding whether clean SSE termination can replace explicit provider finish metadata changes the model-output-to-tool-execution boundary.

options.title: Accept Clean-DONE Tool Execution
options.body: Approve this PR after normal required checks if maintainers accept native tool-call deltas plus raw SSE `[DONE]` as a safe terminal signal.

options.title: Require Exact Provider Confirmation
options.body: Ask for one redacted Evolink or equivalent provider run before merge if maintainers want proof from the originally reported route rather than loopback transport proof.

options.title: Keep Finish Reason Required
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers decide streamed tool execution must continue requiring explicit provider finish metadata.

recommendation.title: Accept Clean-DONE Tool Execution
recommendation.body: Approve this PR after normal required checks if maintainers accept native tool-call deltas plus raw SSE `[DONE]` as a safe terminal signal.

likelyOwner.reason: He reviewed and merged the adjacent guard that defined the current fail-closed behavior and is the clearest available owner for the boundary decision.
